title: Review of fishery sustainability measures – October 2026 round — Updates section
capturedBy: Codex IAB native visible text, Updates section, 29 October 2026; complete relevant update, not whole consultation
text:
27 October 2026: Tarakihi and butterfish limits come into effect from 1 November
As part of the minister’s decisions on the October 2026 sustainability round:
a new daily limit of 10 tarakihi was set in the Auckland-Kermadec, Central, Challenger, and South-East fishing areas
a new daily limit of 5 butterfish was set in the Challenger area.
These changes come into effect from 1 November 2026. Check our fishing rules pages for more details (with updates for tarakihi and butterfish from 1 November).
